title: Vanya and Lanterns
statementMd:
Vanya walks late at night along a straight street of length $*l*$, lit by $*n*$ lanterns. Consider the coordinate system with the beginning of the street corresponding to the point $0$, and its end corresponding to the point $*l*$. Then the $*i*$-th lantern is at the point $*a*_{*i*}$. The lantern lights all points of the street that are at the distance of at most $*d*$ from it, where $*d*$ is some positive number, common for all lanterns.

Vanya wonders: what is the minimum light radius $*d*$ should the lanterns have to light the whole street?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$, $*l*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *l* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of lanterns and the length of the street respectively.

The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *l*$). Multiple lanterns can be located at the same point. The lanterns may be located at the ends of the street.

## Output

Print the minimum light radius $*d*$, needed to light the whole street. The answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

## Note

Consider the second sample. At $*d* = 2$ the first lantern will light the segment $[0, 4]$ of the street, and the second lantern will light segment $[3, 5]$. Thus, the whole street will be lit.
statementZhMd:
Vanya 深夜沿着一条长度为 $*l*$ 的笔直街道行走，街道上有 $*n*$ 盏灯笼照明。建立如下坐标系：街道的起点对应点 $0$，终点对应点 $*l*$。那么，第 $*i*$ 盏灯笼位于点 $*a*_{*i*}$。每盏灯笼会照亮街道上与其距离不超过 $*d*$ 的所有点，其中 $*d*$ 是对所有灯笼都相同的正数。

Vanya 想知道：为了照亮整条街道，灯笼的最小光照半径 $*d*$ 应该是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$、$*l*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *l* ≤ 10^{9}$）——灯笼的数量和街道的长度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *l*$）。多个灯笼可以位于同一点。灯笼可以位于街道的端点。

## 输出格式

输出照亮整条街道所需的最小光照半径 $*d*$。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则认为答案正确。

## 说明

考虑第二个样例。当 $*d* = 2$ 时，第一盏灯笼会照亮街道上的线段 $[0, 4]$，第二盏灯笼会照亮线段 $[3, 5]$。因此，整条街道都会被照亮。
